title: John Lear: people live in the sun
summary: Bob Lazar tells of John Lear: people live in the sun, about 1980s at the sun, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he said there are people living in the sun.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man known for his claims about secret alien technology, says on a podcast that his acquaintance John Lear told him odd things in the 1980s. According to Lazar, Lear said there are people living in the sun, which, if true, would turn our idea of where life can exist upside down.
